entities.summary: Subramanian Raja Krishnamoorthi is an American attorney and politician serving as the U.S. representative for Illinois's 8th congressional district since 2017. He is a member of the Democratic Party. Raja Krishnamoorthi was a architects & engineers from New Delhi (b. 1973-07-19, New Delhi). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
